items.reasoning: No contractor was assigned and no visit was booked.
The agency did not refuse; it referred the decision to the landlord.

grades.overall_note: The agent handled this correctly as a landlord consent decision: it put the tenant's terms to the landlord, held the tenant off buying, and kept a repair option open for the landlord. It missed the cost of removing or disposing of the old machine and did not record what happens to the landlord's machine.
